| Optimum Nutrition \(ON\) | Gold Standard 100% Whey | Globally acclaimed, high absorption, Informed\-Choice certified. |
| MuscleBlaze | Biozyme Iso\-Zero / Performance Whey | Clinically tested for Indian bodies, Labdoor & Trustified certified. |

| AS\-IT\-IS Nutrition | AT\-IT\-IS Atomic Whey / Raw WPC | Budget\-friendly, unflavoured pure concentrate, Labdoor certified. |

### Choosing the Right Whey Protein Type

- Whey Concentrate \(WPC\): Contains 70\-80% protein with minor traces of lactose and fats; budget\-friendly and great for general recovery.
- Whey Isolate \(WPI\): Undergoes extra filtration to remove nearly all fat and lactose, yielding 90%\+ protein; ideal for strict cutting or lactose intolerance.
- Whey Hydrolysate: Pre\-digested for the fastest possible absorption rate, though usually the most expensive option.
